method: Node VM + native Canvas. Synthetic entry fixtures; ordinary input/target actions. No enemy HP or victory overrides.

results.name: Coordinated groups telegraph before attacking; bounded states
Pause freezes formation, dog attacks, torpedoes and progression
In-flight new save roundtrip preserves groups and next attacks
Legacy convoy save continues byte-equivalent mission state
Desktop and joystick inputs move the player; shared weapon commands
Idempotent modules do not add frame owners/listeners/emitter wrappers
Render is read-only; finite meshes and depth fallback at both aspect ratios
